notes.title: Collab Release: CryptoNinja Sakuya × NINPCHI!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="1oTP6YsSYbU;full"][/previewyoutube]
We’ve launched a special collaboration event with the TV anime “Shinobanai! CryptoNinja Sakuya” starting at 8:00 PM (JST) on Monday, July 7, 2025.



The anime’s third season (“Shinobanai! CryptoNinja Sakuya: Volume 3”) also premieres on the same day on TOKYO MX. To celebrate the occasion, NINPCHI! CRYPTONINJA PETIT is featuring an exclusive in-game event that brings the anime’s unique world into the game!





The event is available now in the browser version (alpha) of NINPCHI! CRYPTONINJA PETIT.





In this special collaboration, characters from the anime appear as brand-new playable characters in the game.
New stages and enemy characters inspired by the show have also been added.

Fans of the series will recognize familiar elements throughout, letting you enjoy the world of the anime in NINPCHI!’s charming pixel art style.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381402/d932d3bbeec860e746b1d0039d7a4b38058d9130.png"]

The characters’ appearances, attack effects, and in-game animations are filled with playful touches and clever references to the anime.



Fans will find plenty of fun surprises that are sure to bring a smile to their faces.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381402/657b5805b3ee6ba53d6c54c7207be8626cafbba0.png"]

notes.title: Demo ver1.6.0 Update
notes.notes:
In order to provide a comfortable playing environment for more players, we have implemented a localization update.

■Contents of the update

・English support for in-game text .
・Critical bug fixes
・Fixed a critical bug.
・Other minor bug fixes

This update makes the in-game text more natural and easier to understand.
We will continue to make improvements to provide a better game experience for everyone.
